observing.naked_eye: Bright and easy to see unaided; use Mirfak as a primary landmark for the surrounding constellation.
observing.binoculars: Binoculars isolate the star from the surrounding pattern and make star-hopping easier. The field lies within the Almanack's visible Milky Way boundary, so the background is especially star-rich.
observing.telescope: A telescope sharpens the local field and helps inspect nearby companions; the star itself remains an unresolved point of light.
